# 🧺 Chapter 3: Mutual Funds

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
Units, NAV, fund types, costs and factsheets.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [How a Mutual Fund Works](/mutual-funds/3.1-how-a-mutual-fund-works) - Learn how pooling, units, NAV and AUM work, and the SEBI safeguards behind every mutual fund scheme.
2. [Types of Funds](/mutual-funds/3.2-types-of-funds) - Understand equity, debt, hybrid, liquid and ELSS funds, and how SEBI categorises mutual fund schemes.
3. [Fund Costs](/mutual-funds/3.3-fund-costs) - Understand expense ratio, direct vs regular plans, exit load, and how small cost differences add up over 20 years.
4. [Index Funds, ETFs, Active vs Passive](/mutual-funds/3.4-index-funds-etfs-active-vs-passive) - Understand index funds, ETFs, tracking error, and the active vs passive investing debate, including Bogle and Malkiel's arguments.
5. [Reading a Factsheet](/mutual-funds/3.5-reading-a-factsheet) - Learn how to read a mutual fund factsheet, including benchmark, riskometer, portfolio and rolling returns, and what to ignore.

::: tip 📖 How to read
Go in order. Every new term is explained the first time it appears, and each unit ends with a keywords table.
:::
